cmo_brief.text: Good morning, Dr. Castellanos. Three quality signals today.

points: BP control is 58% and needs 65% in 58 days.
412 hypertensive members are within 10 points of control, so the target is reachable.
Also: an imaging cluster at Winnemucca and 73 members to recapture.

chips: Show me the 412 closest to control

cmo_winnemucca.text: At Winnemucca, low back pain imaging has run at 27% of eligible visits since April, against 9% across the network.

points: 71% of the $162K in low-value imaging comes from Winnemucca.
No red-flag diagnoses were coded in the flagged cases.
Three rotating clinicians order at the same rate: a missing order set, not one provider.

cmo_close.text: Blood pressure is the one to win.

points: About 210 of the 412 should reach control; 180 gets you to 65%.
268 drive over an hour: a telehealth recheck with a home cuff counts for CMS165.
Mailed FIT kits add about 4 points to colorectal screening: worth starting, though short of the gate this year.
HbA1c will not move enough in 58 days: plan it for Q1.
